title: Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States for Molecular Potential Energy Surfaces in Second Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2609.37733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Second-quantized neural-network quantum states have achieved accurate molecular energies, but extending them across molecular geometries requires a shared representation of the geometry-dependent wavefunction coefficients. We introduce geometry-conditioned foundation neural-network quantum states for molecular electronic structure in second quantization. A single autoregressive model learns a family of ground states from sparse anchor geometries and provides wavefunctions at untrained geometries without further optimization. Orbital alignment matches orbital identities and transports their phases, establishing an aligned orbital basis across geometries. Frozen energies reach chemical accuracy at every untrained query geometry for N$_2$, CO, and H$_4$. translated_title: 二次量子化框架下分子势能面的基础神经网络量子态
translated_abstract: 二次量子化的神经网络量子态已经能够实现精确的分子能量计算，但将其扩展到不同分子几何构型，需要对依赖于几何构型的波函数系数建立共享表示。我们提出了面向二次量子化分子电子结构的几何条件化基础神经网络量子态。单一自回归模型从稀疏的锚点几何构型学习一族基态，并能在未经训练的几何构型处直接给出波函数，无需进一步优化。轨道对齐方法匹配轨道身份并传输其相位，从而在不同几何构型间建立起对齐的轨道基。对于N₂、CO和H₄，冻结参数的模型能量在每一个未训练的查询几何构型处均达到化学精度。在其他分子路径上，经能量训练的波函数无需任何性质标签即可给出偶极矩、四极矩和自然轨道占据数。在三个成对的N₂训练种子上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出几何条件化的基础神经网络量子态，用单一自回归模型从稀疏锚点几何构型学习一族分子基态，在任意未训练几何构型下无需再优化即可给出化学精度能量，并无需性质标签即可预测偶极矩、四极矩等分子性质。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces geometry-conditioned foundation neural-network quantum states in second quantization, where a single autoregressive model trained on sparse anchor geometries delivers wavefunctions at untrained geometries with chemical accuracy and property predictions (dipoles, quadrupoles, natural occupations) without further optimization or property labels.
